normative_composition.rule: Every R2 clause remains normative unless this R3 names it in replaced_r2_clauses. R3 has precedence only for those replacements. Unknown or conflicting composition is fail-closed Violated.
replaced_r2_clauses: runtime_origin_proof.proof_limit gains mandatory externally pinned candidate source evidence
checker_must_validate candidate-free live-file equality is forbidden and replaced by baseline_candidate_separation
seal_gate requirement candidate-free pins unchanged is replaced by historical baseline pins unchanged plus independently pinned live candidate evidence
preserved_r2_closures: append-only challenge-bound raw ledger before projection
Unknown only after every non-payload predicate
normal/repeat/reverse rejection of fixed IDs and post-hoc rechain

l0_assessment.reason: The contradiction is entirely in the acceptance evidence: the frozen L0 already permits the cfg-only hooks, ledger, carrier and facade. Separating historical baseline attestation from post-patch candidate evidence changes no public contract, product default, pipeline phase or compatibility surface.

historical_baseline.purpose: Prove what the candidate-free source view contained before implementation and bind the exact 19-row manifest, 18 applicable hooks, Rust symbols, branches, anchors, snippets and L0 ownership.
historical_baseline.authority: A sealed preseal issued after R3 must attest the exact binding R3 and a byte-readable candidate-free source/AST snapshot. R2 preseal is historical evidence only and is invalid as the current seal.
historical_baseline.baseline_file_sha256: Historical evidence only. It is checked against the sealed candidate-free view, never against the live post-patch file.
historical_baseline.immutability: Manifest, baseline attestation, anchors and snippets remain pinned after the R3 preseal.

live_candidate.purpose: Prove what the independently observed post-patch source contains and that only authorized observation changes connect the real hooks to the runtime ledger.
live_candidate.whole_file_hashes: Compute SHA-256 over every complete live file named by the 19 composed rows and compare those digests to the external candidate evidence. Do not compare them to baseline_file_sha256.
live_candidate.structural_evidence: For every row, resolve the inherited Rust symbol and branch, the unique anchor, and immediate cfg(p1339_observation) append/transport adjacency. Record candidate symbol and anchor snippet digests.
live_candidate.allowed_diff: Compare the live Rust AST and bytes with the preseal's candidate-free snapshot. Every difference must lie wholly inside a declared cfg-only boundary owned by a manifest row or the authorized test-only facade; outside the union, bytes and AST are unchanged.
live_candidate.writer_projection: Prove exactly one append writer, enumerate all callsites, reject alternate raw writers and post-hoc constructors, and prove every projection path read-only.
live_candidate.runtime_coverage: Map actual normal/repeat/reverse raw receipts to all 19 rows with H00D/H00S exclusivity and the inherited per-cell cardinalities before projection.

baseline_candidate_separation.non_equivalence_rule: current_candidate_file_sha256 == baseline_file_sha256 is neither generally required nor sufficient. A changed authorized file is expected. An unchanged file that lacks the required candidate binding fails structural or runtime evidence, not a historical-hash comparison.

external_candidate_source_evidence.schema_source: candidate_source_evidence_contract in the pinned binding R3
external_candidate_source_evidence.created_when: After the complete candidate patch and before candidate acceptance.
external_candidate_source_evidence.creator: An independent candidate-source verifier that did not author the patch, DTO, facade, contract, oracle or preseal.
inputs: sealed R3 preseal pin supplied outside candidate control
exact R3 contract and binding pins
external_candidate_source_evidence.pinning: The verifier computes the whole evidence artifact SHA-256 and supplies path plus digest directly to the candidate checker invocation. The checker rehashes the bytes before parsing.
external_candidate_source_evidence.dto_facade_exclusion: Neither the DTO nor p1342_run_fixture_for_test may declare, embed, select, replace or authenticate the preseal pin, candidate evidence path/hash, whole-file hashes, allowed-diff verdict, writer verdict or structural binding verdict. Candidate output may expose raw runtime data only as allowed by R2.
external_candidate_source_evidence.fail_closed: Missing, stale, candidate-authored, unpinned, schema-open, structurally incomplete or runtime-disconnected evidence is Violated.

trusted_invocation_inputs: reissued R3 preseal path and SHA-256
external candidate source evidence path and SHA-256
R1 L0 freeze path and SHA-256
candidate DTO and raw preprojection snapshot
validation_order: 1. Rehash R3 contract, binding, fixture, L0 freeze and reissued preseal from verifier-controlled pins.
2. Require the preseal to pin R3 and attest the exact historical manifest, baseline file hashes, anchors, snippets and candidate-free source/AST view.
3. Rehash and parse the externally pinned post-patch candidate source evidence; reject any value sourced only from DTO/facade.
4. Rehash each complete live candidate file and compare only with its candidate_file_sha256 in external evidence.
5. Rust-parse every row's symbol/branch/anchor/cfg adjacency, validate allowed-diff boundaries, writer uniqueness, projection read-only status and runtime receipt coverage.
6. Apply all inherited R2 raw-ledger, carrier, Location, snapshot, event, attempt-kind/R, ordering and payload predicates.
7. Permit Unknown only for deliberately opaque dict-witness after steps 1-6 succeed; every earlier failure is Violated.
candidate_checker_contract.explicit_prohibition: The checker must not compare any live candidate file digest with baseline_file_sha256. It must not trust static evidence inside the DTO or facade.
candidate_checker_contract.fixed_and_posthoc_negatives: A06 fixed identifiers and A07 post-hoc rechain remain valid negatives and must be rejected through the inherited challenge/raw/source/runtime rules, not dismissed by case classification.

causal_invalidation.reason: Changing the protected contract and binding invalidates every downstream R2-derived oracle, preseal and RED test artifact under the segregation chain.
causal_invalidation.category_rule: Any other oracle, adversary, checker, preseal, test or receipt whose protected inputs pin contract/binding R2 is invalid for R3 even if not enumerated here.
required_reemission_order: R3 preseal plus baseline source/AST attestation
causal_invalidation.preserved_history: R1 and R2 artifacts remain immutable historical records; invalidation means they cannot authorize or judge R3, not that they are edited or deleted.

blocker_closure.implementation_blocker_r1: CLOSED_BY_CONTRACT_DESIGN: candidate-free hashes attest only the historical preseal view; live candidate hashes and structure are proved by a separate independently pinned post-patch artifact.
blocker_closure.B01: Exact composed manifest, closed R3 metadata, sealed historical anchors/snippets and independently pinned Rust-aware live source evidence.
blocker_closure.B02: R2 carrier, Location and real continuous snapshot rules remain unchanged and are joined to external row coverage.
blocker_closure.B03: R2 append-only/raw-before-projection proof remains unchanged; external writer/projection audit prevents DTO-only self-attestation.
blocker_closure.B04: R2 fresh challenges and cross-run identity rules remain unchanged; external whole-file and runtime evidence rejects fixed implementation shortcuts.
blocker_closure.B05: R2 fail-closed precedence remains unchanged; static/preseal/evidence failures occur before payload opacity.

scope_exclusions: public API, default behavior, pipeline phase or compatibility changes
